  • Iranian missiles and rockets continue striking southern and central Israel. Northern border sees daily Hezbollah activity.

Northern Border

Hormuz & Shipping

  • Pakistan mediates. Deal secured to send ~20 ships through Strait of Hormuz.
  • Iran permitting passage for select 'friendly' states (Russia, India, China); restricting others.

Civilian impact & infrastructure

  • Fire in Ramat Hovav raises hazardous-materials risk near Beer Sheva.
  • Jerusalem: Latin Patriarch prevented from entering Church of the Holy Sepulchre during Palm Sunday — local tensions rising.
  • Airspace: Iran and Iraq airports reportedly closed; commercial traffic reduced.

Military posture & intel

  • Israeli interceptor systems under elevated strain beyond Iron Dome. Ammunition and logistic pressure reported.
  • Information warfare active: conflicting damage claims and rapid rebuttals from CENTCOM and Iranian media.

International actions

  • Pakistan operationally engaged in mediation and shipping arrangements.

🟢 Good News

  • Pakistan secured a practical shipping corridor through Hormuz for 20 vessels.
  • CENTCOM publicly refuted key IRGC damage claims, reducing misinformation impact.
Threat assessment: Escalating
